properties.role: Tide-reader and boatwoman at Gullwick Docks
properties.played_as: Whispers as if the water might hear her; never looks anyone in the eye, keeps her gaze on the tide line; grey braid, salt-stained coat, mending a net.
properties.wants: Will row the party for two silver, but never at night.
properties.knows: Only her boat goes near the bell water; Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang.

sources.quote: She talks in a whisper, like the water might hear her, and she never once looks you in the eye. She keeps her gaze on the tide line.

changes.why: New NPC the GM voiced, with how she was played.

sources.quote: She says she'll be at pier four tomorrow at first light if you want the ride.

changes.why: Records where the table last saw Sela.

change.name: Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang

properties.statement: Forty years ago the Saltmere Mine flooded the same night the bell first rang, and the water came up warm.

sources.quote: Saltmere flooded the same night the bell first rang. Forty years ago. My grandmother said the water came up warm.

changes.why: Sela links the mine's flooding to the bell's first ringing.

sources.quote: Saltmere flooded the same night the bell first rang.

changes.why: The fact is about Saltmere Mine.

properties.details_shown: Up the cliff path, about an hour from Gullwick. A black mouth in the chalk, timber frame half rotted, a rusted cart on its side. Warm air smelling of church candle wax. Thirty paces in the tunnel is flooded with warm black water; wet hymn-book pages float on it and cling to the walls.
properties.state: Flooded; warm water; bad air that hurt Oren.

sources.quote: About thirty paces in, the tunnel floods. Black water, and it's warm to the touch.

changes.why: The party entered the mine and saw its state.

properties.what_changed: Teo found a wet hymn-book page in Saltmere Mine with "M. Brand" pencilled in the margin and recognised Mira's handwriting: she was there.

sources.quote: A hymn about the sea giving back what it takes. And in the margin, in pencil, someone wrote "M. Brand".
That's Mira. That's my sister's handwriting. She was here.

changes.why: New evidence on Teo's goal about Mira.

change.name: Is Maren Vosk in the cult?

properties.what_is_open: Dana and Priya suspect harbor-master Maren wanted the party gone and is running the choir. Unconfirmed player guess.

sources.quote: I bet the harbor-master is behind all this. Maren wanted us gone from day one. She's in the cult, I'm calling it.
Yeah, Maren is totally running the choir.

changes.why: Players raised a suspicion; the GM did not confirm it.

sources.quote: Maren wanted us gone from day one.

properties.statement: Fishermen say the Kelp Mother pulls children who stand too close to the water down by the ankles; whether she is real is not established.

sources.quote: The Kelp Mother takes children who stand that close. Pulls them down by the ankles. Everyone knows that.
That's what the fishermen say.

changes.why: Local legend told by fishermen, kept as rumor.

properties.details_shown: Sank into the bay with its bell. At low water the roof sticks out: just the bell tower and two broken arches, seaweed hanging from the stones. At midnight the bell rang twelve times under the water, with a loud humming, and pale shapes stood in rows on the chapel floor like a congregation before vanishing.

sources.quote: The drowned chapel's roof sticks out of the bay at low water, just the bell tower and two broken arches.
Shapes. Pale shapes, standing on the chapel floor under the water, in rows. Like a congregation.

changes.why: The party saw the chapel and the midnight apparition.

sources.quote: (to himself) That's the choir clock at three of six.

changes.why: The GM advanced the hidden clock from two to three.

properties.details_shown: Tavern by the docks; fire going, smells of tar and fish stew.

sources.quote: You end up back at the Tarred Gull, the tavern by the docks. Fire going, it smells of tar and fish stew.

changes.why: New place the party used as base.

properties.played_as: Huge, red beard, laughs at his own jokes, wipes the same mug the whole time he talks; feeds the party unasked, on the house.
properties.knows: Has known Maren for thirty years.

sources.quote: Bram is huge, red beard, laughs at his own jokes, and he wipes the same mug the whole time he talks to you.
The innkeeper, Bram, sets down three bowls of stew without being asked.

change.name: Maren lost a brother to the bay

properties.statement: Harbor-master Maren Vosk lost a brother to the bay.

sources.quote: Maren? Thirty years I've known her. Sharp tongue. Good heart. She lost a brother to that bay.
She lost a brother to that bay.

properties.next_step: Tomorrow at first light Sela rows the party out; they dive to the drowned chapel at low tide, by day. Vessa buys rope and a second lantern tonight.

sources.quote: So tomorrow, first light, Sela rows us out and we dive to the chapel at low tide. I'll buy rope and a second lantern tonight.
Agreed. Tomorrow we dive.

changes.why: The party's agreed plan for the bell thread.
